name: Recycling Scheme Facility
subtitle: reduce, reuse, reanimate
rules: When this card enters play, you may draw a card. -- If a character goes to a discard pile, any player may pay 4 to put that card on top of its owner's deck.
flavor: It just so happens that your friend here is only "MOSTLY dead." There's a big difference between "mostly dead" and "all dead." "Mostly dead" is slightly alive. With "all dead," well, with "all dead" there's usually only one thing you can do: go through his clothes and look for loose change.
notes: Card prints 'If a character goes to a discard pile'; catalog says 'When a character is put into a discard pile'. Same play.

name: Siluriformes Flaxenscale
subtitle: avarice incarnate
rules: UNIQUE SILURIFORMES -- All UNIQUE EUSTACE gain 3 strength and 3 life. -- NUMISMATIC EMISSION -- COST – Pay 5. -- EFFECT – Draw 2 cards. Gain 2 influence. -- AURIFEROUS AUGMENTAION -- COST – Discard 2 cards. -- EFFECT – This turn, this character gains 2 strength and 2 life.
notes: Card itself prints the typo AUGMENTAION.

name: Swindle
subtitle: steal of the century
rules: COST – Your opponents cannot respond to this card. -- EFFECT – Each opponent must attach a resource to their faction. Draw a card. Discard a card.
flavor: There's a sucker born every minute.

name: Thabbashite Financier
subtitle: the living gods call for riches
rules: BLOOD GOLD – [V][V] -- COST – Pay 2. Lose 1 influence. -- EFFECT – You may play a card as a face-down resource.
flavor: The value of gold transcends culture.

name: Timid Mau
subtitle: don't be such a pussy
rules: If this card is blocked by an opposing party of 2 or more characters, it loses 1 speed this turn.
flavor: Kitty gonna cry? Big kitty gonna cry?

name: Underhanded Hang-Out
subtitle: congregation of the criminally-inclined
rules: DIRTY DEALS -- COST – Pay 2. Pick a location you own and inflict 1 damage to it. -- EFFECT – Draw a card.
flavor: Whatcha buyin', stranger?

name: Unexpected Codicil
subtitle: cleverly concealed clause
rules: COST – Choose a number for X. Discard X cards. Pay X - 2. -- EFFECT – Draw X cards. -- FINE PRINT – [G][G][G][G] -- COST – Reveal this card from your hand. Your faction loses 2 influence. Pay 2. -- EFFECT – Draw a card.

name: 5n4p
subtitle: 50 M4ny M4j195!
rules: If this card is restored, put a Micromajig token into play under your control.
flavor: If we could build enough of these, we might just be able to sneak out of this place!
notes: Card prints 'If this card is restored'; catalog says 'When this card restores'. Same trigger.

name: Abandoned Testing Complex
subtitle: technological treasure trove
rules: At the start of your turn, you may pay 3. If you do you may play a resource.
flavor: Buried deep beneath layers of Clockman's history, it is not clear who had built it or why. The archives in Acrolos had no record of this place, but yet they found Kaiser prototypes, node terminals, all manner of the most advanced voidal technologies. The greatest prize of all, however, was the Testudine. Surely that was what the Emperor's ghost had meant for them to find.

name: Accumulation Majig
subtitle: MOAR!
rules: At the start of your turn you may pay 1 for each token on this card. If you don't, destroy this card. -- At the end of your turn put a token on this card. -- FEED -- COST – Pay 3. -- EFFECT – Remove a token from this card.
flavor: om nom nom nom

name: Clockman Junk Picker
subtitle: ooh, a thing!
rules: When this card enters play, you may search your deck for an item and reveal it. If you do, put it into play as a face-down resource. -- TRASH – [E][E][E][E][E][E] -- COST – Pay 1. Pick an item. Destroy this card. -- EFFECT – Destroy that card.

name: Elitistmajig
subtitle: above the fray
rules: CRUNCH -- COST – Destroy a Micromajig token you control. -- EFFECT – This turn, this card gains "PROVIDES – [E][E][E]". -- [E][E][E][E][E][E] – This card gains 2 strength and 2 life.
flavor: Be the 1%.

name: EPM (Extra Powerful Magnetic) Pulse
subtitle: yes, yes it is
rules: Destroy all items and locations.

name: Frickin' Sweet Pogo-Bunny
subtitle: terrifyingly cute
rules: RAAR! -- COST – Use this only if this card is not a character and only once each turn. Pay 1. -- EFFECT – This turn, this card gains the "character" type, and gains 2 strength, 2 life, and 3 speed. -- HIDE! -- COST – Pay 1. -- EFFECT – If this card is a character, it loses the "character" type. Deplete this card. -- INTO THE RABBIT HOLE... -- COST – Pay 3. -- EFFECT – Flip this card face-down under its owner's control.
notes: Ability name prints 'INTO THE RABBIT HOLE...' (catalog has '?'); trivial punctuation.

name: Gigantitect's Giant Giant
subtitle: precisely as advertised
rules: This card cannot be picked by non-item cards or non-item abilities. -- Opponents cannot take control of this card.
flavor: GG sir... GG!

name: Industrious Usage
subtitle: don't just sit there looking shiny
rules: COST – Pick an item. -- EFFECT – Destroy the item. Put a Micromajig token into play under your control. -- FLIP UP – 2 [E][E]
flavor: Oh, I'm sorry, did you need that to do something helpful?

name: It's a Trap!
subtitle: see what we did there?
rules: COST – Pick an item you control. Pick a character. -- EFFECT – Put the cards into their owner's hand. -- FLIP UP – 2 [E]
flavor: It just works on so many levels.

name: Jo Ciendeilio, M07h3r 0f 1337
subtitle: best communicator in Acrolos
typeLine: GEARSMITH CHARACTER – jo, blade of questionable morality
rules: UNIQUE JO -- Each character you control gains the following rules text: "WORKING -- COST – Use this only if this card has been in play since the start of the turn. Deplete this card. -- EFFECT – Reduce the next numeric cost you pay this turn by 1."
flavor: Jo was born and raised on the island-complex of Acrolos, which raises the question of where she managed to learn any kind of social graces. She now provides technology in bulk so the rich can resell each piece to the highest warmongering bidder.
notes: Granted ability is named WORKING on the card; catalog names it RESEARCH. Name only, effect identical. Catalog also says 'gains:' for the printed 'gains the following rules text:'.

name: M3CHm4n1c 31f
subtitle: manic machine manipulator
rules: When this card enters play, you may pay 2. If you do, you may put a token on up to 2 different non-resource cards. -- While there is a token on this card, it gains 2 strength and 2 life.

name: Micromajig Recycling Station
subtitle: preserving Lugubria for a better tomorrow
rules: At the start of your turn, you may choose a number for X and destroy X Micromajig tokens you control. If you do, reduce the next numeric cost you pay this turn by X+1.
flavor: This product made with at least 60% post-consumer majig parts.

name: Micromajigmakermachinemajig
subtitle: I swear they're breeding or something
rules: RELEASE THE MAJIGS! -- COST – Deplete this card. Pick an opponent. That player may put a Micromajig token into play under their control. This turn, all damage inflicted to that token is reduced to 0. -- EFFECT – Put a Micromajig token into play under your control. -- PREPARE -- COST – Pay 2. -- EFFECT – Restore this card.

name: Pwny Bomb
subtitle: tiny equine explosives
rules: The attached character gains 1 strength and 1 life. -- If a Micromajig token or "horsemajig" character enters play under your control, you may attach this card to it. -- PWNED -- COST – Pick a Micromajig token or "horsemajig" character that this card is attached to. Pick a character. Destroy this card. -- EFFECT – Inflict 7 damage to the picked characters. -- MOVE -- COST – Pick a character you control. Pay 3. -- EFFECT – Attach this card to the character if you can.
flavor: Friendship is tragic.
notes: Card prints 'If a Micromajig token or "horsemajig" character enters play under your control'; catalog says 'When ...' (trigger templating). Badges: +1 STR, +0 SPD, +1 LIFE.

name: R3p347 0ff3nd3r
subtitle: screw the rules - i has an awesome suit
rules: This card can attack even if it has not been in play under your control since the start of your turn. -- When this card enters play, you may pay 2. If you do, put a token on it. -- While there is a token on this card, it gains 1 strength and 1 life. -- P3PP3R 61457 -- COST – Remove a token from this card. Use this only once per turn. -- EFFECT – This turn, this character gains 1 strength and 1 life. Restore it.
notes: Card prints 'since the start of your turn'; catalog says 'since the start of the turn' (same play, attacks only happen on your turn). Footer also credits 'original Open R&D concept by Asuryan'.

name: Reluctant Reconciliation
subtitle: i'll get it up and working again!
rules: COST – Pick a character. -- EFFECT – Restore that character. This turn, it cannot attack.
flavor: To help close a deal that was quickly going south, Jo offered her skillful services to Eustace by restoring his broken majig.

name: Rocket Lawnchair
subtitle: don't try this at home...
rules: TACTICAL -- NO EJECT! -- COST – Pick a character you own. Pick a character your opponent controls. Destroy this card. -- EFFECT – Destroy the characters. If either character was a member of an opponent's attacking party, destroy all characters in that party. -- FLIP UP – 4 [E][E]
flavor: ...unless you sign a waiver first.
notes: Card prints 'a character your opponent controls'; catalog says 'a character an opponent controls'.

name: Runic Junker
subtitle: looks down on everyone
rules: At start of your turn you may pay 4. If you do and you control atleast 2 face-down resources, pick an opponent. That player must pick a face-down resource you control. If the face-down resource is a character or an item you may play it for free. (You still need to meet its threshold and satisfy its extra costs.)
flavor: The Runic Junker has many trunks, and Jo has junk in every one of them.
notes: Card prints 'you may play it for free'; catalog says 'deploy it for free' (updated terminology). Footer also credits 'original Open R&D concept by GooDMaN88'.

name: Runic Map
subtitle: we only have one chance to get there, well maybe two
rules: This card enters play with 2 tokens on it. If there are no tokens on this card destroy it. -- PLAN -- COST – Pay 1. Remove a token from this card. -- EFFECT – Search your deck for a card named "Elitism" and reveal it. Put it into your hand. -- FOLLOW PLAN -- COST – Pay 2. Remove a token from this card. -- EFFECT – You may play a resource. -- NEW PLAN -- COST – Destroy a face-down resource you control. -- EFFECT – Add a token to this card.
notes: Card prints 'If there are no tokens on this card destroy it'; catalog says 'When there are no tokens...' (same state-based destroy).

name: Sockem Bot
subtitle: arch nemesis of rockem bot
rules: PAY OFF -- COST – Any player may use this ability. Pay 1. -- EFFECT – This turn, if damage is inflicted to a character or faction by this card, reduce the amount by 1.

name: Stuttershy
subtitle: silent and ruthless
rules: If this card would be destroyed, flip it face-down under its owner's control instead. -- If this card is flipped down, each opponent's faction gains 1 influence and you may put a Micromajig token into play under your control for each influence gained this way.
notes: Card prints 'If this card is flipped down'; catalog says 'When this card is flipped down' (trigger templating).

name: Testudine Autoframe
subtitle: smarter than your average luteoderm
rules: UNIQUE TESTUDINE -- When this card enters play, you may remove a UNIQUE JO you control from the game. If you do, this turn, each other character you control gains 1 strength and 1 life. -- All characters you control can attack even if they have not been in play under your control since the start of the turn. -- If this card leaves play, put a UNIQUE JO that was removed from the game by this card into play under your control.
notes: Card prints 'remove ... from the game' / 'If this card leaves play'; catalog uses current 'put into the void' / 'When this card leaves play' terminology.

name: Thabbashite Armorer
subtitle: the living gods call for weapons
rules: FOR THABBASH – [V][V][V] -- COST – Pay 2. -- EFFECT – This turn, this card gains 1 strength and 1 life. -- TAMESHIGIRI – [V][V][V][V][V][V] -- COST – Pay 2. Your faction loses 2 influence. -- EFFECT – This turn, this card gains 2 strength and 2 life.
flavor: ...and the maker is honored to test them first.

name: Backdoor Brigand
subtitle: screw you guys, I'm going home
rules: EXIT STAGE RIGHT -- COST – Use this only if this card has not assigned damage this turn. Pay 1. -- EFFECT – Flip this card face-down under its owner's control. -- FLIP UP – 3 [D][D]
flavor: Look! Over there! A distraction!

name: Banana Peel
subtitle: surprisingly effective against giants too!
rules: TACTICAL -- COST – If you played this card during an opponent's turn you may pay 1. If you don't, terminate it. -- SLIP -- COST – Pick an attacking character. Destroy this card. -- EFFECT – Flip that card face-down under its owner's control. Draw a card. -- FLIP UP – 3 [D][D][D]
notes: Card prints COST and 'If you played this card'; catalog uses EXTRA COST and 'deployed' (updated templating).

name: Bottlebeard Brandyshanks
subtitle: bottomless imbiber of booze
rules: UNIQUE PLUCK -- The top card of each opponents' deck is revealed at all times. If any of those cards are a character, this card gains 3 speed. -- CHUG! -- COST – Pay 2. Pick an opponent. -- EFFECT – Put the top card of that player's deck on the bottom of their deck.
flavor: The liver is evil and it must be punished. Sobriety is the enemy.
notes: Footer also credits 'original Open R&D concept by GooDMaN88'.

name: Bug Bite
subtitle: once a drug, now a nuisance
rules: COST – Pick a character. -- EFFECT – Put a token on the character. Destroy it if it has at least X tokens on it, where X is its numeric cost. -- RECUR – [D][D] -- COST – Use this only if this card is in your discard pile. Pay 4. Remove this card from the game. Pick a character. -- EFFECT – Put 2 tokens on the character. Destroy it if it has at least X tokens on it, where X is its numeric cost.

name: Carnival Ringmaster
subtitle: specialist in chicanery and showmanship
rules: TACTICAL -- When this card enters play you may add it to your attacking or blocking party. All characters in that party gain 1 speed. -- When this card enters play you may pick a character. If you do, put a token on that card.

name: Cicibeo the Swift
subtitle: deft hands, swift feet
rules: UNIQUE CICIBEO -- TACTICAL -- COST – Discard a non-resource Rogue card. -- [D][D][D][D][D][D] – If another "cicibeo" card enters play from your hand, you may pick a character and take control of it.
flavor: Excellent dancer, better pickpocket.
notes: Card prints 'If another "cicibeo" card enters play from your hand'; catalog says 'When another "cicibeo" card enters play, if it was deployed from your hand' (templating, same condition); catalog also uses EXTRA COST for the printed COST.

name: Clockman City Shuffle
subtitle: oh, I say!
rules: This turn, characters you control gain 1 strength and 1 life and characters your opponents control lose 1 strength and 1 life.
flavor:
It's a blindfold kick back type of a game
Called the Clockman City Shuffle.
Whereas you look left and they fall right
Into the Clockman City Shuffle.
It's a they-think you-think they don't know type of Clockman city hustle.
Where you take your time, wait your turn, and hang them up and out to dry.
— Pluck
notes: Flavor is verse (each line kept on its own line); attribution printed as '-Pluck'.

name: Drive By Boobing
subtitle: hooters, honkers, jibbly-jubblies!
rules: COST – Pick a character that inflicted damage to your faction this turn. -- EFFECT – Remove that character from the game.
flavor: In other news, tits!

name: Elusive Wolf
subtitle: he ain't nothing like a hound dog
rules: HOWL -- COST – Destroy a card named "Deception" you own. -- EFFECT – Put a token on this card. -- PROWL -- COST – Remove a token from this card. -- EFFECT – This turn, this card gains COVERT.

name: Gang Weapon Dealer
subtitle: Maybe I got something for you, eh?
rules: This card enters play with 2 tokens on it. -- This card gains 1 strength for each token on it. -- DELIVERY -- COST – Remove a token from this card. Deplete this card. Reveal a face-down "gear" card you control. -- EFFECT – You may play it even if you cannot meet its threshold. If its numeric cost is 4 or less, you may play it for free.
flavor: You can never be too rich, too good looking, or too well armed!
notes: Card prints 'you may play it'; catalog says 'deploy it' (updated terminology). Footer also credits 'original Open R&D concept by TomekS'.

name: Gassy Gastornis
subtitle: tastes like chicken
rules: TACTICAL
flavor: smells like a three day old corpse stuffed with garlic and bear poop

name: Guileful Astucion
subtitle: disappearances can be deceiving
rules: COST – Pick a character. -- EFFECT – Choose one of the following as this card's effect: -- OPTION 1 -- This turn, the character loses 1 numeric cost. Draw a card. -- OPTION 2 -- This turn, the character gains 1 numeric cost. Draw a card. -- OPTION 3 -- This turn, the character gains 1 speed. Draw a card.
flavor: Does putting on dem shades really help that much?!

name: Draconic Luteoderm Suit
subtitle: fits like a glove. an ichorous, bloodthirsty, vengeful glove
rules: UNIQUE DRACONIC LUTEDODERM SUIT -- The attached character gains 2 strength and 2 life. -- If any other "gear" card is played, you may draw a card. -- SERAPHIM FUSION -- COST – Use this only if this card is attached to a UNIQUE JO. Pay 3. Destroy this card. -- EFFECT – Search your deck for a card named "Testudine Autoframe" and put it into play. -- EQUIP -- COST – Pick a character. If it is a UNIQUE JO then X is 0, otherwise X is 2. Pay X. -- EFFECT – Attach this card to the character.
notes: Card prints 'If any other "gear" card is played'; catalog says 'is deployed' (updated terminology). The UNIQUE line prints 'LUTEDODERM' (typo on the card, matches catalog) while the title reads 'Luteoderm'. Badges: +2 STR, +0 SPD, +2 LIFE.
